slug: 2025-12-22 Government begins 99th cycle of LEAP cash-grant payments

facts.fact: The Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection says LEAP cash-grant disbursement, a government social transfer paying about 350,580 households in its 99th cycle from 22 December 2025, increasingly runs on mobile-money-enabled G2P rails.

systems.owner: Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection
